messages:
Riley: Starting the change-window publish for SDK py/ts -> target release 2.0.0. Deprecating legacy sync client. Plan: publish canary, roll to 15% -> 50% -> 100% over ~25m. Soft-pin legacy dist-tag 'legacy-sync' for the window. Will post relnotes PR shortly.

Maya: I have the release notes draft and a short migration snippet. PR will include the pin example and a note about the new auth flow compatibility.

Jordan: On publish-watch. @deploy-bot queue when infra-green please. We'll sign wheels and verify checksums before PyPI promote.

deploy-bot: publish job queued: job_id=810201
deploy-bot: starting job 810201 — steps: build:py -> wheel, sign:py -> gpg, build:ts -> tarball, publish:py -> pypi (test), publish:ts -> npm (canary). CI link: https://ci.internal/jobs/810201

Sam: Confirmed secrets: PyPI key at /prod/pypi/redwood-sdk/key-2026-06, npm token rotated and present as npm-rot-2026-06. No extra secret ops.

deploy-bot: python build & sign OK
```
python -m build --sdist --wheel
gpg --detach-sign -a dist/redwood_sdk-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl
# dist/redwood_sdk-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl, .asc
```

deploy-bot: npm pack + publish (canary) OK
```
npm pack ./packages/sdk && npm publish ./redwood-sdk-2.0.0.tgz --tag canary
```

Priya: Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1550 — includes changelog, migration steps, and pin snippet. Pin example in PR:
```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.7 legacy-sync
# python: pin in requirements.txt: redwood-sdk==1.9.7
```

Maya: Quick QA note: one intermittent TS test around session refresh failed in CI (runner #12) but not in the publish job. No errors observed in canary sampling so far. Filed ISSUE-1257.

Riley: Thresholds: abort if error rate >0.6% or any uncaught exceptions appear in production sampling. If we need immediate rollback we'll rm the canary tag and reassign latest -> previous stable (npm unpublish not an option).

Sam: Commands for emergency rollback (copy to runbook):
```
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.7 latest
promote-pypi --version 1.9.7 --to prod
```
I'll be ready to run them and monitor alerts for 40m postpublish.

deploy-bot: canary smoke checks: 8/8 nodes sampled, 0/800 errors in traffic sampling. :white_check_mark:

legal-bot: Heads-up: transitive dep `fast-serialize` v2.2.0 has an attribution requirement in license. Requesting brief attribution text in release notes.

Priya: Noted. I'll add attribution line to the release notes and docs PR. If legal blocks, fallback is to yank canary and patch out the dep ASAP.

legal-bot: Quick review complete  APPROVED w/ attribution. No block.

Riley: Proceeding to shift traffic to 15%. Legacy-sync dist-tag will remain pinned for 24h post rollout.

deploy-bot: traffic shift -> 15% complete. Sampling 1.2k reqs, error rate 0.11% (baseline 0.09%).

Maya: Observed a single stack trace in one canary node referencing auth-token refresh. Triage in progress, but not widespread.

Riley: Keep feature-flag for the new auth flow enabled but add a short-lived retry wrapper. If errors climb above threshold we rollback.

Jordan: Moving to 50% in 12m if metrics stable. Also reminder: GPG signatures verified for the wheel.

deploy-bot: traffic shift -> 50% complete. Sampling 3k reqs, error rate stable at 0.10%. No new uncaught exceptions.

Priya: Docs PR merged; changelog, migration snippet, pin example, and attribution included. Release notes published internally.

Riley: Promoting PyPI from test -> prod in 5m if no regressions. Keeping legacy-sync pinned for now.

deploy-bot: promoting PyPI package to prod: promote-job=810201-promote
deploy-bot: promotion complete. PyPI v2.0.0 prod and npm canary still applied.

Sam: Monitoring alerts set for 60m. I'll post immediately if any revert needed.

deploy-bot: post-rollout sampling 5k reqs, error rate 0.09% (within targets). Job 810201 closed: status=success, duration=9m02s.

Riley: Leaving rollout at 100%. I'll publish a short post-publish summary tomorrow with latency, error, and cost deltas plus a deprecation timeline for the sync client. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
